title: Exponential-time probabilistic languages
statement: The class consists of the languages $L$ of finite Boolean strings for which there exist natural numbers $e,c$ and a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Booleans such that $N$ satisfies the bounded-error exponential-time decision condition for $L$ with time bound $n\mapsto c(n^e+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A language $L$ of finite Boolean strings
There exists a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Booleans
caveat: The underlying bounded-error decision predicate is not defined in the supplied payload, so the class is described using its stated role.
